company.name: Tecton
company.shortDescription: Tecton provides an enterprise-ready feature store to make machine learning accessible to every company.
company.description:
Tecton provides an enterprise-ready feature store to make machine learning accessible to every company. It believes that companies need a new kind of data platform built for the unique requirements of ML. 
Its goal is to enable ML teams to build great features, serve them in production quickly and reliably, and do it at scale. By getting the data layer for ML right, companies can get better models to produce faster and drive real business outcomes.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that automates the creation, management, and serving of machine learning features from batch, streaming, and real-time data sources.
productsAndServices.name: Tecton Feature Platform

productsAndServices.description: A Python-based framework for defining and managing feature transformations from various data sources for ML applications.
productsAndServices.name: Feature Engineering Framework

productsAndServices.description: A managed service to create and serve embeddings for vector similarity search and point lookups in ML applications.
productsAndServices.name: Embeddings Service

productsAndServices.description: A system to develop, manage, and retrieve context-rich prompts for large language model (LLM) applications.
productsAndServices.name: Prompt Engineering Lifecycle Management

productsAndServices.description: Automated orchestration and management of data pipelines to materialize and serve ML features reliably.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Data Pipelines

productsAndServices.description: A serving system that delivers features with low latency and high throughput for real-time ML inference.
productsAndServices.name: Feature Serving Infrastructure
